newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr tracking dlr/mark.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr tracking dlr/mark.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly easier against the dollar on Wednesday, tracking the dollar/mark's movements, dealers said.
The forint, which opened the day at 170.20/30, ended close to the central bank's resisatance level at 170.46/51, down from 170.35/40 at noon.

"There were hardly any deals so the forint just followed the dollar/mark -- it was very quiet," said Noemi Koppendorfer of Magyar Hitel Bank, adding that she expected little change over the next few days.
The yen dominated currency futures trade on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), accounting for over half of the modest 3.18 billion forints turnover.
The yen, mark and Ecu eased for almost all maturities while sterling and the dollar strengthened and the Swiss franc ended mixed, the BCE said on its CBUE Reuters page.
